title: Route coding agent requests to the right model on Amazon Bedrock with NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard
summary: Coding agents work in tasks, and the number that matters is cost per solved task, not price per token. In this post, you use the AWS CDK to deploy LiteLLM with the NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard routing plugin on Amazon Bedrock, then measure cost per solved task for a routed model group
reason: Tutorial/how-to post on deploying LiteLLM with NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard on Bedrock. No new model release, no research artifact, no business event, no policy action, and no new OSS tool/framework release announcement.
